data.name: Moosa
data.gender_notes: Moosa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Drawn from the water. The name Moosa carries the meaning “Moses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Moosa usually hope their child will grow to embody moses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine guidance and leadership
data.etymology: Moosa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moosa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: موسى
in_arabic.meaning: اسم نبي الله في القرآن الكريم ومعناه منبت أو مطروح
in_arabic.long_meaning: موسى هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي ورد في القرآن الكريم، ويعني النبي أو المولود في غير أوانه، ويشير إلى منبت أو مطروح. ورد اسم موسى في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، منها سورة البقرة وسورة آل عمران وسورة النساء وسورة الإسراء. يعتبر موسى من الأنبياء المهمين في الإسلام، حيث قاد بني إسرائيل في مواجهة فرعون وظل رمزًا للنصر الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: موسیٰ
in_urdu.meaning: پیغمبر موسیٰ، بنی اسرائیل کا رہنما، فرعون کے خلاف اٹھ کھڑے ہوئے
in_urdu.long_meaning: موسیٰ ایک اہم نام ہے جو اسلامی تاریخ میں بنی اسرائیل کے پیغمبر کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے 'پیدائش' یا 'ایک بچہ پیدا ہوا'۔ قرآن میں موسیٰ کا ذکر کئی سورتوں میں کیا گیا ہے، جن میں سورہ البقرة، سورہ آل عمران، سورہ النساء اور سورہ الإسراء شامل ہیں۔ موسیٰ کی کہانی اسلامی ثقافت اور تاریخ میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتی ہے، خاص طور پر مصری فرعون کے خلاف ان کی لڑائی اور خدا کی طرف سے دی گئی شریعت کے ساتھ۔

in_hindi.name: मूसा
in_hindi.meaning: मूसा नबी, इस्राइल के नेता, परमेश्वर के द्वारा भेजा गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: मूसा एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में इस्राइल के नबी के रूप में जाना जाता है। इसका अर्थ है 'जन्म' या 'एक बच्चा पैदा हुआ'। कुरआन में मूसा का उल्लेख कई सूरतों में किया गया है, जिनमें सूरह अल-बक़राह, सूरह आल इमरान, सूरह अन-निसा और सूरह अल-इसराअ शामिल हैं। मूसा की कहानी इस्लामी संस्कृति और इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखती है, विशेष रूप से मिस्री फ़िरौन के खिलाफ उनकी लड़ाई और परमेश्वर द्वारा दी गई शरीयत के साथ।

in_pashto.name: موسى
in_pashto.meaning: د بني اسرائيلو پيغمبر، د فرعون په وړاندې ولاړ
in_pashto.long_meaning: موسى د بني اسرائيلو د پيغمبر په توګه يو مهم نوم دی. د هغه مطلب دى 'پيدايښت' يا 'يو ماشوم پيدا شو'. په قرآن کې د موسى ذکر په ډېرو سورتو کې شوی دی، لکه سوره البقره، سوره آل عمران، سوره النساء او سوره الإسراء. د موسى کيسه د اسلامي کلتور او تاريخ په منځ کې يو مهم ځای لري، په ځانګړي ډول د مصري فرعون په وړاندې د هغه مبارزه او د خدای لخوا ورکړل شوې شريعت سره.

in_english.name: Moosa
in_english.meaning: Prophet Moosa, leader of Israelites, messenger of God
in_english.long_meaning: Moosa is a significant name in Islamic tradition, known as the Prophet of the Israelites. It means 'born' or 'a child born'. The name Moosa is mentioned in several surahs of the Quran, including Surah Al-Baqarah, Surah Al-Imran, Surah An-Nisa, and Surah Al-Isra. Moosa's story holds a crucial place in Islamic culture and history, particularly his confrontations with the Egyptian Pharaoh and the reception of the divine law. Moosa is considered a pivotal figure in Islam, leading the Israelites and symbolizing divine support and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Moosa in Islamic culture is of significant historical importance as it is believed to be the name of Prophet Moses (AS) in the Quran and the Islamic Traditions. He was referred to as "Musa" in the Arabic language. Prophet Moses is considered one of the major Prophets in Islam, and his story is recounted in detail in both the Quran and Hadiths. He played a prominent role in the political and spiritual history of the People of Israel and guided them from infancy to adulthood. His name is still remembered and revered throughout the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Moosa has deep roots in Islamic tradition. Moosa is believed to be chosen by God Almighty from his mother's womb, and his life story is an embodiment of submission to Allah and his unwavering faith in his Lord. Prophet Moosa proved the monotheistic nature of God to the Pharaoh, and the story of his struggle to lead the Children of Israel out of slavery in Egypt is a powerful reminder of Allah's Mercy and Compassion towards His Creation. The name Moosa is a reminder of the importance of faith, courage, and determination in following Allah's Guidance, and of the ultimate victory that awaits those who remain steadfast in their faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Moses" symbolizes Drawn from the water. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Moosa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of moses.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Prophet Musa (Moses) is a central figure in the Torah, the Hebrew Bible, and the Quran. The name Moosa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Prophet Musa (Moses) is a central figure in the Abrahamic religions, known for leading the Israelites out of Egypt and receiving the Ten Commandments from God.

trends: used as a common name in the Muslim world
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Moosa remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
